verdict.rationale: Runpod documents official Serverless SDKs for Python, JavaScript, and Go [runpod-docs-70]. It also ships an official `@runpod/ai-sdk-provider` package for the Vercel AI SDK, with type-safe text, streaming, image, and video generation [runpod-docs-61]. Flash adds Python `@Endpoint` functions that run on remote GPUs [runpod-docs-66, runpod-docs-15], and vLLM workers let you use OpenAI client libraries [runpod-docs-59]. Missing for 10: evidence that the SDKs cover the full platform (Pods, volumes, clusters) beyond Serverless and Public Endpoints, a published OpenAPI spec for generating clients (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
